# NonDoc

> > Independent journalism covering Oklahoma politics, education policy, and culture with a focus on legislative accountability and community voices.

NonDoc provides investigative reporting and commentary on Oklahoma state politics, education funding debates, charter school controversies, and cultural issues. Founded by William W. Savage III, the publication features analysis of the Oklahoma Legislature, OKCPS policy decisions, and diverse creative content including poetry and local profiles.

## Key Topics

- Oklahoma politics
- Education funding and policy
- Oklahoma Legislature
- Charter schools and KIPP expansion
- Oklahoma City Public Schools (OKCPS)
- Sales tax initiatives
- Teacher pay and budget crisis
- OCPA Impact
- Oklahoma Supreme Court decisions
- Legislative accountability
- Initiative petitions
- Church-state separation
- Earthquake regulation
- Independent journalism
- Political commentary

## Oklahoma Politics & Legislature

- [Legislator unsure if First Amendment should cover Islam](https://nondoc.com/2016/06/21/legislator-unsure-if-first-amendment-should-cover-islam): Rep. Pat Ownbey questions whether Islam deserves First Amendment protection
- [OK Supreme Court upholds education initiative petition](https://nondoc.com/2016/01/12/ok-supreme-court-upholds-education-initiative-petition): Oklahoma Supreme Court approves education sales tax initiative petition
- [Filter: Knock knock ... it's the Oklahoma Legislature](https://nondoc.com/2016/01/25/filter-knock-knock-its-the-oklahoma-legislature): 2016 Oklahoma Legislature session preview covering bills and proposals
- [Facing attack, OKGOP's Estela Hernandez could be a star](https://nondoc.com/2015/10/08/facing-attack-gops-estela-hernandez-could-be-a-star): Estela Hernandez faces political attack mailer in OKGOP leadership race
- [WTF: Legislative panhandling and government inaction](https://nondoc.com/2016/05/13/wtf-legislative-panhandling-and-government-inaction): Oklahoma Legislature budget crisis and education funding commentary
- [Pressed releases: Dems spew vitriol, OKC app updated](https://nondoc.com/2016/06/17/pressed-releases-dems-spew-vitriol-okc-app-updated): Oklahoma Democrats' press releases and TSET CEO salary controversy review

## Education Policy & Funding

- [Hostility punctuates OKCPS community meetings](https://nondoc.com/2016/04/28/pent-up-hostility-punctuates-okcps-community-meetings): OKCPS community meetings reveal tensions over KIPP charter expansion
- [OCPA Impact: More than a 'penny tax' in Boren proposal](https://nondoc.com/2015/12/01/ocpa-impact-more-than-a-penny-tax-in-boren-proposal): OCPA Impact challenges David Boren's education funding sales tax initiative
- ['Intense' experiences at Moon highlight KIPP's limitations](https://nondoc.com/2016/04/18/intense-experiences-at-moon-highlight-kipps-limitations): Dr. John Thompson compares KIPP charter to Moon Middle School neighborhood needs
- [Test prep: 'Feed the teacher, or he will eat the kids'](https://nondoc.com/2016/01/06/test-prep-feed-the-teacher-or-he-will-eat-the-kids): Dr. John Thompson on EOI test prep and teaching to the test challenges
- [Predatory University of Phoenix could be burning out](https://nondoc.com/2015/10/13/predatory-university-of-phoenix-could-be-gone-soon): DoD bans University of Phoenix from military base recruiting
